findings.title: Apple sends fresh wave of mercenary spyware warnings worldwide - 9to5Mac
findings.summary_md: Apple notified users in 110 countries who it suspects may have been targeted by spyware attacks. The report notes Apple sent these threat notifications on August 13, 2026, and that they now appear on the lock screen.

findings.title: If Apple sends you a push notification alerting you to a spyware attack, take it seriously - TechCrunch
findings.summary_md: Apple told TechCrunch it sent notifications on Thursday (August 13) to users targeted in 110 countries. The notification reads as a high-confidence mercenary spyware attack alert delivered directly to the device lock screen.

findings.title: Apple sends new 'Threat Notification' alerts over mercenary spyware attacks - BleepingComputer
findings.summary_md: Apple sent a fresh wave of threat notifications warning targeted users in 110 countries of mercenary spyware attacks. Published August 13, 2026, the article confirms the notifications began that week and are more visible than prior rounds.

findings.title: Apple Issues New Spyware Warning To iPhone Users In 110 Countries - Forbes
findings.summary_md: Apple confirmed sending new mercenary spyware alerts to iPhone users in 110 countries, with reports emerging from users who received notifications around August 13. The article notes the scale of the campaign and how users can verify the alert.
